## Triage: first touch · `pm:queue` · grade kept (`enhancement`, `priority:p3`, `domain:ui`) · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-15T06:53Z

Read fresh. `sharedUserFeeds.ts` keeps polling approvals and the inbox every 60 s while a tab is hidden, forever. One forgotten tab kept both scale-to-zero staging containers awake around the clock (Cloudflare analytics, about $1.5 a day, against close to zero with no tab open).
- **The grade and lane are kept as filed:** p3, `domain:ui` (`packages/app-shell`).
- **Scope:** the card's proposal. Stop arming the timer after N minutes (10 suggested) continuously hidden, and keep the immediate refetch on visibility (#4225). Apply the same rule to every poller that reads `document.hidden` / `visibilityState`, from one shared helper (⛔ not a copy per poller). Pin both the stop and the resume.

Claim: PM loop round 1

Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` reads no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card`
Thread-read: 6186333502
Serial constraints cleared: no in-flight `domain:ui` claim touches `sharedUserFeeds.ts` or `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/`. objectui#12423 (plugin-list / plugin-view / components / app-shell `PageHeader.tsx`, `ObjectView.tsx`), objectui#12427 (app-shell `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`, `useNavPins.ts`, `FavoritesProvider.tsx`, views) and objectui#12433 (plugin-detail) are disjoint. The last change to `sharedUserFeeds.ts` on main is 5039e81 (#12250).

## Review: ACCEPT — objectui PR #12445 · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-15T08:09Z

Reviewed on GitHub at head `d7a0d58`, against triage's scope (`6186333502`) and the claim (`6186836402`), not against the dev's report.

- **Shape:** the PR is a draft against `main`. Its body opens `Fixes #12439`, the only closing keyword, followed by `Clause-②: no`. The governed sweep reads NOT governed, 454 lines (+454 / −0), 6 files.
- **One shared helper, ⛔ not a copy per poller (triage's ruling), met:**
  - New internal module `hooks/hiddenTabPollStop.ts` holds the one clock: `HIDDEN_POLL_STOP_MS` (10 minutes, a constant, as the claim ruled), `hiddenForMs()` and `isPollingSuspended()`. It reads `document.hidden` at call time and keeps one `visibilitychange` listener, so hide → show → hide restarts the clock.
  - It is not re-exported from any package entry, so `Clause-②: no` holds.
  - The dev re-grepped `packages/` and `apps/`: `sharedUserFeeds.ts` is the only timer poller that reads visibility. `useAiUsage`, `useInboxArrivalNotifier` and the console's inbox-arrival preview read visibility but arm no timer. This matches the seat's own reading at claim time.
- **The stop:** `SharedFeed.schedule()` arms nothing while suspended, and a poll or probe tick that comes due after the cut-off sends nothing and re-arms nothing. So the last request a hidden tab makes falls inside the 10-minute window.
- **The resume:** unchanged. The existing `onVisibilityChange` refetch (#4225) is the only way out: one immediate read per feed, then its `finally` re-arms the foreground cadence.
- **Headers:** `sharedUserFeeds.ts` (a new section, plus the `HIDDEN_POLL_MS` and `onVisibilityChange` docs) and `useInboxArrivalNotifier.ts` (no desktop notification after 10 minutes hidden; the message arrives as the in-page toast on return) both say the trade-off.
- **Pins and ablation:** 4 feed pins (the 60 s hidden cadence under the cut-off, then zero requests and zero armed timers; exactly one read per feed on return, then the foreground cadence; the clock restarting on each hide; the feeds asking the shared clock) plus the helper's own tests. Stubbing the helper to `false` in `sharedUserFeeds.ts` fails 3 of the 9 (stop, restart, shared clock). The return pin stays green, as expected: the return path is the pre-existing handler. Restore was proven by blob hash.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`.
- **Evidence:** the closure build and type-check exit 0. `src/hooks/` gives 536/536 and the 13 feed-consumer files outside it give 117/117, under the lock. The battery exits 0. The full app-shell project is declared to CI; its shards are read below.
- **Acceptance note (not filed):** `plugin-dashboard`'s `useDashboardAutoRefresh` polls at an author-set `refreshIntervalSeconds` and ignores visibility. It reads no visibility, so it is outside this card's rule, and it runs only where an author opted a dashboard into auto-refresh; no reach was measured.
- **CI at head:** 34 success, 3 skipped, 0 failures (`filter=latest`, 37 runs), all 12 test shards included.

Next: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.
